concepts.label: Couchbase Search Advanced API
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - checked fts:manager-options-endpoint (round 23's promoted /api/managerOptions surface) first per this round's briefing, but this page's actual content is a DIFFERENT REST surface entirely: /api/pindex (partition definition/query) and POST /pools/default (memory quota) - not one mention of /api/managerOptions or any advanced-settings tuning parameter anywhere on the page, despite the shared 'Advanced' title wording. Genuine first-contact mint for the umbrella API this page describes.

notable_absence.finding: The Set Search Memory Quota endpoint's ftsMemoryQuota form parameter is documented only as 'The memory quota for the Search service. Example: 56' - the page never states the unit (presumably MB, by analogy with other memory-quota settings elsewhere in the docs, but this page does not say so), nor a default, minimum, or maximum value, nor what happens if the value is set too low.

cross_component_finding: This page's Query Response schema for POST /api/pindex/{pindexName}/query is a bare {status, results} object where results is typed only as 'Object array' with no further schema - much thinner than the fully-modeled fts:search-response-object (status/hits/errors/took) used elsewhere in the Search docs for the main query-service response. The page does not state whether this is a deliberately reduced admin/debug response shape for single-partition queries or simply an underspecified Swagger-generated definition; left as a finding rather than asserted as a relation since no page states which.
cross_product_finding: Not applicable - no Capella twin exists for this page's endpoints per this round's framing.
